element.enlightened.none.title: No bending
element.enlightened.earth.title: Earthbender
element.enlightened.air.title: Airbender
element.enlightened.water.title: Waterbender
element.enlightened.fire.title: Firebender
element.enlightened.earth.broadcast: %s read the Earth Scroll and became an Earthbender!
element.enlightened.air.broadcast: %s read the Air Scroll and became an Airbender!
element.enlightened.water.broadcast: %s read the Water Scroll and became a Waterbender!
element.enlightened.fire.broadcast: %s read the Fire Scroll and became a Firebender!
ability.enlightened.rock_throw.desc: Rocks tear out of the ground in front of you and fly at what you look at: one, two or three at once as you master it. Needs earth under your feet.
ability.enlightened.rock_lift.desc: Look at a block of earth and press to tear it out and hold it in the air (up to one, two or three blocks). Press again while looking at nothing to throw them all.
ability.enlightened.earth_armor.desc: Wrap your body in a shell of rock that leaves only your eyes open: strong protection, but you walk slower. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.earth_pillar.desc: The ground rises under your feet as a pillar (3, 5 or 8 blocks) and carries you up to high places. It crumbles after a while.
ability.enlightened.earth_wall.desc: A wall of earth rises in front of you (3, 5 or 7 blocks wide) and shields you from rocks and arrows for ten seconds.
ability.enlightened.seismic_sense.desc: Standing on the ground you feel every creature's steps: they are outlined through walls, farther as you master it. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.sand_wall.desc: A wall of sand, like the earth wall, raised where sand is near.
ability.enlightened.sand_lift.desc: Sand swirls up around you and flies at your enemy as a blinding cloud (one, two or three). Needs sand near you.
ability.enlightened.quicksand.desc: The sand under your enemy turns to quicksand and he sinks in it. An adept turns earth to sand too. A stronger earthbender cannot be sunk.
ability.enlightened.lava_path.desc: The ground ahead of you melts into a path of lava toward where you look (4, 7 or 10 blocks) for a few seconds. You do not burn in it.
ability.enlightened.lava_shuriken.desc: A spinning disc of lava that burns whoever it hits.
ability.enlightened.lava_skin.desc: Fire and lava hurt you less: a quarter less, half, three quarters. Passive.
ability.enlightened.metal_wall.desc: A wall of iron, like the earth wall. Needs metal near you or in your pack.
ability.enlightened.metal_blades.desc: Sharp blades of metal fly at your enemy (one, two or three). Needs metal near you or in your pack.
ability.enlightened.metal_armor.desc: Full armour of metal over your whole body but the eyes: the best protection, and the slowest. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.metal_pull.desc: The metal in the ground round you (iron, gold, copper ore, ancient debris) comes out of the rock into your pack, and loose metal on the ground with it. More metal as you master it.
ability.enlightened.wreck.desc: Tear metal devices apart: furnaces, pistons, rails, hoppers, iron doors (1, 3 or 6 at once); minecarts and iron golems too.
ability.enlightened.air_blast.desc: A wave of air throws everyone in front of you back, farther as you master it.
ability.enlightened.air_shield.desc: A sphere of air round you turns arrows back and keeps creatures out. When it breaks, it bursts: everyone round you is thrown and hurt. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.air_jump.desc: Shoot air at the ground and fly up high. With the Air Glider in hand you then glide on the wind.
ability.enlightened.air_blades.desc: Cutting blades of air (one, two or three) that do two and a half hearts each.
ability.enlightened.spirit_projection.de: Your spirit leaves your body in meditation and looks about freely, through walls and into caves. If anything attacks your body you return at once.
ability.enlightened.air_bubble.desc: A bubble of air round your head lets you breathe under water. Passive.
ability.enlightened.air_scooter.desc: Ride a ball of air: great speed, and you never fall hard. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.tornado.desc: Send a small tornado at your enemies: it lifts and spins them. Bigger and longer as you master it.
ability.enlightened.flight.desc: Only an airbender who let go of his earthly tethers flies. Toggle; press again to take off or land.
ability.enlightened.suffocate.desc: Take the air out of an enemy's lungs while you hold the key, unless he gets far away from you. Only for the tetherless.
ability.enlightened.water_whip.desc: A whip of water lashes what you look at. The first art of every waterbender; it is what carries your water.
ability.enlightened.water_healing.desc: Heal yourself, or the friend you look at, with water, and wash poison away.
ability.enlightened.octopus_form.desc: Water wraps round you with eight arms: they guard you, strike whoever comes close, and lash out round whoever you hit. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.water_spout.desc: Ride a spout of water up into the air (6, 12 or 20 blocks) over any water, and push whoever stands in it. Sneak to come down. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.water_arms.desc: Long arms of water on your hands: you hit harder and reach farther. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.plant_water.desc: Far from water you draw it out of the plants round you; they wither. Passive.
ability.enlightened.ice_knives.desc: Knives of ice (one, two or three) that freeze whoever they hit.
ability.enlightened.freeze.desc: Freeze the creature you look at in place, or the water in front of you into ice.
ability.enlightened.snow_throw.desc: Three snowballs that slow whoever they hit.
ability.enlightened.ice_wall.desc: A wall of ice in front of you. Fire melts it fast; water is strong against fire.
ability.enlightened.bloodbending.desc: Take hold of a creature or a player up close and move him like a puppet; press again to throw him. Below mastery only under a full moon. A stronger waterbender cannot be held.
ability.enlightened.blood_suppress.desc: A master bloodbender takes the bending of the bender he holds: ten minutes for a weak bender, a minute or two for a skilled one.
ability.enlightened.fire_skin.desc: Fire hurts you less: half, a quarter, then not at all. Passive.
ability.enlightened.fire_ball.desc: A ball of fire at what you look at: tap for a small one, hold the key for the big one (bigger as you master it).
ability.enlightened.fire_fist.desc: A stream of fire from both hands while you hold the key. A master who sneaks breathes a bigger flame from his mouth.
ability.enlightened.fire_whip.desc: A whip of fire in your hand lashes whoever you look at, farther as you master it. Everyone it touches burns.
ability.enlightened.fire_ring.desc: A spin of fire from your hands burns everyone round you; an adept spins with his legs too, wider and hotter.
ability.enlightened.fire_healing.desc: Heal yourself or a friend with the warmth of fire, and burn poison away. Weaker than water healing.
ability.enlightened.lightning.desc: Gather lightning for a moment and strike: four and a half hearts and a stun. A master strikes with both hands for six. Long to recharge.
ability.enlightened.lightning_redirect.d: Take the stance: lightning that strikes you is caught. A novice is burned two times in three, an adept half the time; a master sends it all back at what he looks at. Toggle.
item.enlightened.scroll.desc: Read it to become a bender of %s
item.enlightened.scroll.desc2: A bender of its element reads it to open the Bending Scroll
item.enlightened.water_skin.desc: A waterbender's water away from any lake. Right-click water to fill it.
item.enlightened.air_glider.desc: In an airbender's hand it opens as he falls and he glides on the wind.
item.enlightened.air_glider.desc2: Dye it in a crafting table for the colour you like.
message.enlightened.scroll_hint: Press K to open your Bending Scroll: your abilities, your points and your keys.
message.enlightened.look.none: This element has only one look
message.enlightened.empty_slot: Nothing on this key. Open the Bending Scroll (K) to put an ability here.
message.enlightened.suppressed: Your bending was taken from you for a while!
message.enlightened.learn.wrong_element: %s is not an art of your element
message.enlightened.learn.tethered: %s is only for an airbender who let go of his earthly tethers
message.enlightened.learn.gate: %s needs %s points spent on your element first
message.enlightened.hungry: You are too hungry to bend
message.enlightened.not_allowed: You may not bend that one
message.enlightened.scroll.other_element: You already bend %s: this scroll is not yours to read
message.enlightened.earth.no_sand_under: He does not stand on sand
message.enlightened.earth.no_metal_aroun: No metal in the ground round you
message.enlightened.earth.metal_pulled: %s pieces of metal came to you
message.enlightened.earth.seismic_on: Seismic sense on: stand on the ground to feel
message.enlightened.earth.quicksand_stro: %s is the stronger earthbender: the sand will not take him
message.enlightened.air.flight_on: You fly as the tetherless do
message.enlightened.air.projection_canno: Sit on the ground, still, to leave your body
message.enlightened.air.projection_start: Your spirit leaves your body for %s seconds. Press again to return.
message.enlightened.air.projection_attac: Your body was attacked: you are back in it
message.enlightened.air.projection_over: Your spirit returns to your body
message.enlightened.air.projection_back: You are back in your body
message.enlightened.air.projection_far: Too far from your body: the tether pulls you back
message.enlightened.air.tetherless: You have let go of your earthly tethers. The sky is yours: flight and suffocation can be learned, and your air strikes harder.
message.enlightened.water.no_water: No water: find a lake, a water skin or (a master) plants
message.enlightened.water.blood_moon: Bloodbending answers only under the full moon
message.enlightened.water.blood_close: Bloodbending is taken up close: within four blocks
message.enlightened.water.blood_stronger: %s is the stronger waterbender: his blood will not answer
message.enlightened.water.suppress_needs: Only a master of bloodbending takes bending away
message.enlightened.water.suppress_no_be: You must hold a bender in your grip first
message.enlightened.water.suppressed: You took the bending of %s for %s seconds
screen.enlightened.scroll.points: Points to spend: %s (spent: %s). Click an ability, then a key. + learns the next level.
command.enlightened.loadout.failed: That ability is not learned, or cannot sit on a key
command.enlightened.reset: Reset the abilities of %s player(s); the points were refunded
death.attack.enlightened.air_burst: %1$s was caught in a bursting shield
death.attack.enlightened.blood.player: %1$s was bent like a puppet by %2$s
death.attack.enlightened.flame: %1$s burned in a stream of fire
death.attack.enlightened.lightning: %1$s was struck by a firebender's lightning
ability.enlightened.shockwave.desc: A stomp sends a wave of earth out all round you: everyone near is hurt, thrown back and shaken.
ability.enlightened.catapult.desc: The earth flings you the way you look, far and high; you land as if on a cushion.
ability.enlightened.earth_grab.desc: The ground closes round the legs of the creature you aim at and holds it; aimed at nothing, it pulls the loose items on the ground to you.
ability.enlightened.earth_tunnel.desc: Hold: the earth and sand ahead are dug away as you look at them (wider for a master).
ability.enlightened.density_shift.desc: Passive: you land on earth without harm (on anything, as an adept); a master's heavy landing shakes the ground.
ability.enlightened.earth_step.desc: Passive: a double tap of a direction dashes you through a burst of dust; double tap Jump to hop.
ability.enlightened.extraction.desc: Metalbending: the raw metal is torn out of the ore you aim at, one to three pieces.
ability.enlightened.air_suction.desc: A gust that pulls what you look at to you: creatures, arrows, loose items.
ability.enlightened.air_burst.desc: A sphere of air bursts out of you, throwing everyone round you back.
ability.enlightened.air_spout.desc: A column of wind lifts you off the ground; Sneak to come down. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.air_agility.desc: Passive: lighter on your feet, you run faster, and from the second level jump higher.
ability.enlightened.air_step.desc: Passive: a double tap of a direction dashes you on a gust; double tap Jump to hop.
ability.enlightened.water_shield.desc: Hold: a dome of water over you that turns arrows aside and takes most of every blow; it drinks your water.
ability.enlightened.water_bubble.desc: A pocket of air under the water for you and the friends beside you. Toggle.
ability.enlightened.phase_change.desc: Icebending: the water you aim at freezes into a sheet of ice; ice and snow you aim at melt.
ability.enlightened.frost_breath.desc: Hold: a cone of frost from your mouth that slows and, held long enough, freezes solid.
ability.enlightened.plant_tether.desc: A vine from the plants near you lashes the creature you aim at and drags it to them; aimed at nothing, it pulls you to the plant.
ability.enlightened.fast_swim.desc: Passive: the water carries you swiftly; an adept breathes longer under it, a master as long as he likes.
ability.enlightened.water_step.desc: Passive: a double tap of a direction dashes you in a sheet of water; double tap Jump to hop.
ability.enlightened.fire_jet.desc: Flames from your feet throw you the way you look for a moment; you land softly.
ability.enlightened.fire_shield.desc: Hold: a dome of fire round you that burns arrows and bending away and scorches whoever steps in.
ability.enlightened.wall_of_fire.desc: A wall of fire rises where you look, burning and throwing back whoever crosses it, for a while.
ability.enlightened.blaze.desc: An arc of fire runs over the ground ahead of you, setting it alight and burning whoever stands in it.
ability.enlightened.heat_control.desc: Toggle: your heat melts the snow and ice round you, keeps you from freezing and burning, and (an adept) boils the water at your feet away.
ability.enlightened.illumination.desc: Toggle: a flame on your hand lights your way.
ability.enlightened.fire_step.desc: Passive: a double tap of a direction dashes you in a flare of fire; double tap Jump to hop.
ability.enlightened.combustion.desc: Combustionbending: a beam from your third eye that explodes where it lands, far away, after a breath of focus.
message.enlightened.earth.grab_no_earth: There is no earth under it to grab with.
message.enlightened.earth.no_ore: That is no ore of metal.
message.enlightened.water.no_plants: There are no plants near to bend.
message.enlightened.meditate.ground: Sit down on the ground to meditate.
message.enlightened.meditate.begin: You breathe, and the world goes quiet...
message.enlightened.chakra.points: The %s chakra waits: spend %s points on your element first.
message.enlightened.chakra.all: All seven chakras are open. Meditate a breath longer to enter the Avatar State.
message.enlightened.avatar.rest: The Avatar State needs %s more seconds of rest.
combo.enlightened.twister.desc: Air Shield, Tornado, Air Blast: a cyclone that runs along the ground.
combo.enlightened.air_sweep.desc: Air Blades, Air Blades, Air Burst: a fan of blades that sweeps the field.
combo.enlightened.earth_dome.desc: Earth Wall, Shockwave: a dome of earth closes round you.
combo.enlightened.earth_pillars.desc: Shockwave, Earth Pillar, Earth Pillar: pillars under every enemy near fling them into the air.
combo.enlightened.ice_wave.desc: Water Spout, Freeze: a wave of ice sweeps ahead and freezes all in it.
combo.enlightened.ice_bullets.desc: Ice Wall, Ice Knives, Ice Knives: a storm of ice bullets.
combo.enlightened.fire_kick.desc: Fire Ball, Fire Ball, Fire Ring: an arc of fire kicked from the feet.
combo.enlightened.fire_spin.desc: Fire Shield, Fire Ring: a whirl of flame spinning out far and wide.
block.enlightened.meditation_point.desc: Meditate on it to open your chakras three times as fast.
enlightened.configuration.avatar: Chakras, the Avatar State, combos and steps
